name: Conveyor Agent
postStartCommand: { if ! command -v claude >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "[conveyor] Installing Claude Code CLI"; npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code@latest; fi; INSTALLED=$(conveyor-agent --version 2>/dev/null || echo "0.0.0"); LATEST=$(npm view @rallycry/conveyor-agent version 2>/dev/null || echo "$INSTALLED"); if [ "$INSTALLED" != "$LATEST" ]; then echo "[conveyor] Updating agent $INSTALLED -> $LATEST"; npm install -g @rallycry/conveyor-agent@latest; else echo "[conveyor] Agent runner v$INSTALLED is current"; fi ; } || echo "[conveyor] postStart hook failed (continuing)"
